aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.bio: With a background in hospitality, I bring human-centric care to code. I bridge the gap between people and technology, turning client visions into seamless digital experiences through empathy, clarity, and technical precision.
aboutMe.location: Based in Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. Working worldwide
aboutMe.curiosity: Finding better ways to solve problems is what makes building things exciting. Technology never stops evolving, and neither do I.
aboutMe.approach: Every challenge is a feedback loop. My approach blends analytical thinking to dissect root causes with creativity to design clean, non-standard solutions when typical patterns fall short. When hurdles appear, persistence keeps the momentum going, and collaboration ensures every idea gets refined into its most efficient form.

technologies.bio: I leverage modern front-end technologies to build clean, responsive, and user-centric web applications.
